import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    # Generate random string s
    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(random.randint(1, 100)))

    # Generate the array words
    words = []
    word_len = random.randint(1, 5)
    for _ in range(random.randint(1, 10)):
        word = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(word_len))
        words.append(word)

    return s, words
